drhp.business: GSP Crop Science develops, manufactures, supplies and distributes crop-protection Formulations (products of active ingredients plus additives) and Technicals (concentrated active ingredients) across insecticides, herbicides, fungicides and plant growth regulators. It sells domestically on a B-to-B and B-to-C basis under brands such as SLR 525, Platform, PCT-410, All Rounder, Afford, Aurthor, Liger, Raavan, Element, Runway and Fighter, and internationally on a B-to-B basis to customers in 37 countries.
drhp.end_markets: Domestic Business (India) - 88.82% of FY25 revenue from continuing operations|International Business (37 countries incl. Uruguay, USA, Vietnam, Brazil, Singapore, Bangladesh, UAE, Taiwan, Australia, Sri Lanka) - 11.18% of FY25 revenue|Gujarat (largest state, 31.71% of FY25 revenue), Maharashtra (15.03% FY25)
drhp.expansion: The company is expanding its international footprint into the Latin American market, having acquired GSP Agroquimica Do Brasil LTDA in Brazil in 2023, and is in the process of incorporating a subsidiary in Uruguay (subject to approvals). It operates five manufacturing facilities across Gujarat and Jammu & Kashmir with aggregate installed capacity of 15,120 MTPA Technicals, 43,672 MTPA Formulations and 5,400 MTPA Intermediates.

red_flags: Related-party product sales of Rs 1,112.91 million (8.64% of FY25 revenue) to Indo GSP Chemicals Private Limited, a former subsidiary that became a related party in March 2024, plus a Rs 200 million loan given to it in FY24.
17 criminal misbranding cases against the Company (and one against the Material Subsidiary) under the Insecticides Act.
Untraceable RoC filing challans and stated factual inaccuracies in a corporate record.
Terminal Excise Duty recovery contingent liability of Rs 355.31 million (DGFT show-cause; pending Gujarat High Court).
strengths_observed: Over 40 years in agrochemicals with a diversified, research-driven portfolio: 524 CIBRC registrations, 102 patents granted and 108 applications pending; among the first indigenous manufacturers of several patented formulations and technicals (per ICRA).
Sustained margin expansion: gross margin 27.12% (FY23) -> 39.57% (FY25) and EBITDA margin 6.75% (FY23) -> 12.74% (FY25) -> 16.45% (H1 FY26); PAT margin improved to 6.26% (FY25) and 9.56% (H1 FY26).
Healthy return ratios: RoNW 18.38% and RoCE 19.80% in FY25 (from 4.79%/9.00% in FY23).
Low and improving customer concentration: top-10 customers only 19.05% of FY25 revenue (down from 32.70% in FY23).

Backward integration into Technicals and Intermediates (aggregate installed capacity 15,120 MTPA Technicals, 43,672 MTPA Formulations, 5,400 MTPA Intermediates across five facilities); B-to-C distribution via ~5,644 distributors.
Deleveraging use of proceeds: entire Rs 1,700 million debt-repayment object should improve the 0.58x net-debt/equity and reduce interest cost.
